data.raw_text:
LOOK: Motorists endure heavy traffic along Commonwealth Avenue in Quezon City on Monday, March 9.

Senator Francis “Chiz” Escudero proposed that private companies adopt the government’s four-day onsite workweek or implement staggered work-hour schemes to help mitigate the effects of rising fuel prices amid the escalating conflict in the Middle East. 

He noted that such measures could reduce transportation demand, lower operating costs, provide relief to workers, and save billions of pesos currently lost to traffic congestion. 

📷: Santi San Juan | MB
